Definition: from the same as G2226 and G4160; to (re-)vitalize (literally or figuratively):--make alive, give life, quicken.
BiblicalUsage: Zoopoieo means to make alive, to quicken — the Father raises the dead and quickens them, and so does the Son, whom He will. Jesus says the flesh profits nothing; it is the Spirit that quickens, and His words are spirit and life. Paul takes it further: the Spirit that raised Jesus from the dead shall also quicken our mortal bodies, and as in Adam all die, so in Christ shall all be made alive.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that no one quickens himself — life comes from the Father through the Son by the Spirit, and the same power that raised Jesus will raise me. That is my hope on the day my own body fails.
